summary: Christmas is now the whole market: personalised 2026 keepsakes (name baubles, baby's first Christmas, stocking tags) lead Etsy UK, and sets of articulated animals and squishy fidgets are this year's toy-shop and TikTok trends. Black Friday is 27 Nov (deals from about 21 Nov) — list bundles by then, and get advent calendars live by mid-November.

trending.name: Personalised 2026 keepsake ornaments
trending.why: Etsy UK's personalised Christmas pages are led by name baubles and dated '2026' keepsakes (first Christmas, new home, family sets). New dated ornament packs are being featured right now — a 2026 snowflake 6-pack was highlighted on 5 Nov.
trending.printNotes: Two colours on the K2 Plus (name/year in contrast). Flat 3 mm designs print in under an hour; batch a full plate.

trending.name: Baby's first Christmas ornaments
trending.why: 'Baby's first Christmas' is one of the most repeated personalised listings on Etsy UK, and 2026-dated versions (train, rocking horse) are new on MakerWorld this season.
trending.printNotes: Flat 95 mm discs with raised name and date; offer pink/blue/neutral colourways.

trending.name: Articulated animals & sea creatures (sets)
trending.why: Still the most-downloaded print category (articulated dragon tops MakerWorld/Printables). Bundles outsell singles, but single prices have dropped to about £4.50 — sell sets, not one-offs. A megalodon toy is on both the Argos and Hamleys Christmas lists, so sharks are in fashion.
trending.printNotes: Print-in-place, no supports; silk or multi-colour PLA. Check the licence — many popular models are non-commercial.

sources.title: Trendlytic — 3D printed items that still sell on Etsy (Sep 2026)
Made for Mums — Argos top 20 toys for Christmas 2026

trending.name: Squishy & flexi sensory fidgets
trending.why: Hamleys' top Christmas pick is a slow-rise squishy range; on TikTok, flexible printed 'dumpling' squishies, gyro spinners and clicky fidget balls are the current viral 3D prints (late Oct 2026).
trending.printNotes: Flexi designs print well in PLA; true squish needs TPU (K2 Plus handles it). Great as stocking fillers and market impulse buys.

sources.title: Made for Mums — Hamleys top 15 toys for Christmas 2026

trending.name: Refillable advent calendars
trending.why: Reusable printed advent trees and villages with 24 numbered boxes sell at around $40 on Etsy; the selling point is refill every year. Short window — they must arrive before 1 December.
trending.printNotes: Large multi-part print — suits the K1 Max's size or the K2 Plus for two-colour numbers. List by mid-November or skip until next year.

trending.name: Christmas village houses & tree toppers
trending.why: Christmas village sets (stacked mini houses with removable roofs) and star toppers are among the most shared Christmas prints on MakerWorld; they also work as tea-light décor.
trending.printNotes: Sell individual houses so buyers collect them; use white/translucent PLA for tea-light glow.

trending.name: Secret Santa gifts under £10
trending.why: Workplace Secret Santa budgets sit around £10; current UK guides favour novelty keyrings, desk toys and personalised coasters at £3–10.
trending.printNotes: Fast, cheap prints: name keyrings, monitor-top 'peeker' figures, coasters, cable tidies. Bundle 'office pack' listings.

sources.title: John Lewis — Secret Santa gift ideas 2026

trending.name: Lithophane photo lamps
trending.why: Named as one of the 3D-printed items that still holds its price on Etsy in 2026; personalised photo gifts are a Christmas staple.
trending.printNotes: White PLA, 0.12 mm layers; needs an LED tea-light or USB base (cheap to buy in bulk). Order cut-off must allow for printing time.

sources.title: Trendlytic — 3D printed items that still sell on Etsy (Sep 2026)

trending.name: Board game inserts & dice towers
trending.why: Board game organisers sell for about $25–90 and keep their value because they're game-specific; Christmas is peak board-game buying.
trending.printNotes: Long prints (8–20 h) — good use of idle printer time. Pick popular games and check the designer's licence.

sources.title: Trendlytic — 3D printed items that still sell on Etsy (Sep 2026)

trending.name: Planters & desk organisers
trending.why: Planters, pots and desk stands remain steady year-round sellers on Etsy and make easy Christmas gifts for adults.
trending.printNotes: Vase mode or 0.6 mm nozzle for speed; matte and marble PLA look premium.

sources.title: Trendlytic — 3D printed items that still sell on Etsy (Sep 2026)
All3DP — Cool things to 3D print in November 2026

ideas.title: Personalised name bauble — 2026 edition
ideas.description: Flat or dome bauble with a raised name and '2026' in a contrasting colour, sold singly or as family sets.
ideas.designSource: Design it yourself — a simple shape with text; offer fonts and colours.
ideas.why: Dated, personalised keepsakes lead Etsy UK's Christmas pages.

ideas.title: Baby's first Christmas 2026 ornament
ideas.description: Disc ornament with baby's name, '1st Christmas 2026' and a small motif (train, rocking horse, star).
ideas.designSource: Design your own (a free MakerWorld version exists — check its licence before selling).
ideas.why: One of the most repeated personalised listings on Etsy UK.

ideas.title: Snowflake ornament 6-pack
ideas.description: Set of six snowflakes in two sizes with a '2026' keepsake piece, in white, silver or glitter PLA.
ideas.designSource: Design your own or check the licence on the 2026 snowflake pack on MakerWorld.
ideas.why: Fresh 2026 ornament packs are being featured this week; packs raise the order value.

ideas.title: Stocking & gift name tags
ideas.description: Clip-on or hanging tags with a name, for stockings, sacks and presents. Sold in sets.
ideas.why: Personalised stocking items and gift tags are common Etsy UK stocking fillers.

ideas.title: Articulated shark & sea-creature set
ideas.description: Print-in-place shark, megalodon-style shark and octopus sold as a set of three.
ideas.designSource: Use a model whose licence allows selling prints, or buy a commercial licence from the designer.
ideas.why: Sharks are on the Argos and Hamleys Christmas toy lists; sets beat singles now that single animals sell for about £4.50.

ideas.title: Fidget stocking-filler pack
ideas.description: Clicky fidget ball, gear spinner and flexi 'dumpling' squish in one bag.
ideas.designSource: Check the licence of each fidget model; many designers sell commercial licences cheaply.
ideas.why: Squishy sensory toys are Hamleys' lead pick and printed fidgets are trending on TikTok.

ideas.title: Refillable advent tree
ideas.description: Tree with 24 numbered drawers or boxes and a star topper, refilled every year.
ideas.designSource: Check the licence on MakerWorld advent tree models, or design a simple box grid yourself.
ideas.why: Reusable printed advent calendars sell around $40 on Etsy — but list by mid-November.

ideas.title: Christmas village houses (collect them)
ideas.description: Small houses with removable roofs and window cut-outs that glow over an LED tea-light; sold singly or in sets of 5.
ideas.designSource: Design your own or check licences on MakerWorld village sets.
ideas.why: Village sets and tea-light houses are among the most shared Christmas prints on MakerWorld.

ideas.title: Star tree topper with name
ideas.description: Five-point star topper with a hidden clip and optional family name.
ideas.why: Star and angel toppers are the standard Christmas print; personalisation adds margin.

ideas.title: Monitor-top desk buddy
ideas.description: Small figure that peeks over a monitor or laptop edge — a classic Secret Santa gift.
ideas.designSource: Design an original character; avoid film/TV characters you don't have rights to.
ideas.why: Office Secret Santa budgets sit around £10; monitor 'peeker' models are popular on MakerWorld's Christmas collection.

ideas.title: Name keyring Secret Santa pack
ideas.description: Personalised name keyrings in office colours, sold as single gifts or team packs of 10.
ideas.why: Keyrings and personalised items lead under-£10 Secret Santa guides.

ideas.title: Lithophane photo lamp
ideas.description: Curved or cube photo lithophane on a warm LED base, made from the buyer's photo.
ideas.designSource: Generate from the customer's photo (free lithophane tools); buy LED bases in bulk.
ideas.why: Named among 3D-printed items still holding their price on Etsy in 2026.

ideas.title: Board game organiser insert
ideas.description: Box insert for a popular board game, keeping cards and tokens sorted.
ideas.designSource: Check licences carefully; designers often sell commercial licences for inserts.
ideas.why: Inserts sell for $25–90 and Christmas is peak board-game buying.

ideas.title: Dice tower & card deck box
ideas.description: Compact dice tower that folds into a deck box — gift for tabletop players.
ideas.designSource: Design your own or use a commercially-licensed model.
ideas.why: Tabletop gaming accessories remain a steady Etsy and eBay category.

ideas.title: Black Friday bundle: 3 gifts for £20
ideas.description: Pick-any-3 from baubles, keyrings and articulated animals, listed for Black Friday week (from about 21 Nov).
ideas.why: Black Friday is 27 Nov; UK shops start deals around 21 Nov and treat it as a week-long event.

ideas.title: Self-watering planter
ideas.description: Two-part planter with a water reservoir — a year-round gift that also suits Christmas.
ideas.designSource: Design your own or use a model whose licence allows selling.
ideas.why: Planters are steady year-round Etsy sellers.
